codec_contracts.constraints: Transparent String; constructors retain arbitrary strings. Logical protocol key, not OS PID; handler validation belongs to Lead.

Transparent Arc<Vec<u8>> uses base64_bytes: serialize_str(STANDARD.encode); deserialize String then STANDARD.decode. No accepted-byte grammar inferred from JSON Schema; base64 dependency validation is not executed.
Derived untagged String or i64; numeric bounds follow i64, not arbitrary JSON numbers.

Serialize untagged. Custom Deserialize first bounds values to 256*1024 nodes, requires object, dispatches method+id / method / result / error in that order. Duplicate map keys are rejected in ordinary object visitor; serde_json private number/raw wrappers take special paths. No jsonrpc version member emitted by envelopes.

Serialize canonical URL string; deserialize String then PathUri::parse. File-URI validation/canonicalization in impl evidence; Url dependency grammar and host/platform branches are not executed. String JsonSchema does not express this codec.

permissions uses exec_permission_profile_serde via ExecPermissionProfile; required domain cwd is not equivalent to optional wire cwd. Source includes conversion impls; unresolved policy types remain explicit.
Wire permissions are ExecPermissionProfile, cwd Option<PathUri>, policyContext private wire type. Conversion into_context resolves a supplied cwd; do not treat domain derive as ingress contract.
Serialize collect_str(uuid); deserialize String then Uuid::parse_str. Generated IDs are v7; deserializer does not enforce v7. UUID crate grammar remains external.

evidence_kind: STATIC_SOURCE; not accepted-JSON schema or runtime proof
schema_constraints: This inventory schema describes Rust evidence records, never accepted target JSON.
serde attributes/directives are retained separately at container, variant and field sites; no cfg or macro expansion.
serde_derives records derives only; support impls and field helpers carry custom codec evidence.
deserialization_default is lexical metadata. Derived Rust Default is distinct from serde(default); Option omission differs from skip_serializing_if.
No extra-field rejection, nullability, accepted paths, numeric coercion or validation is inferred from type names or exported schemas.
Source-only support retains non-codec impls too; references inside function bodies are not a closed type graph.
span_convention: UTF-8 byte offsets [start,end), 1-based inclusive lines; exact text SHA256

impl fmt::Debug for ExecutorPlugin {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter
            .debug_struct("ExecutorPlugin")
            .field("id", &self.id)
            .field("remote_plugin_id", &self.remote_plugin_id)
            .field("version", &self.version)
            .field("root", &self.root)
            .field("manifest_path", &self.files.manifest.path)
            .field(
                "mcp_config_path",
                &self.files.mcp_config.as_ref().map(|file| &file.path),
            )
            .field(
                "apps_config_path",
                &self.files.apps_config.as_ref().map(|file| &file.path),
            )
            .field("skills", &self.skills)
            .finish()
    }
}
